name: platform-install
notes: Names only. Never put values here. Read by cloud/health.js (/__core/health, /__core/install/plan) and cloud/installer.js (POST /__core/install/apply, /__core/install/rollback).

required.name: config
required.why: Public site config JSON (firebase web config, title, colors).

required.name: googleJson
required.why: Firebase service account JSON used by cloud/fire.js.

required.name: origin
required.why: This site's own origin for links and callbacks.

optional.name: TZ
optional.feature: Scheduled jobs run in local time

optional.name: manifest
optional.feature: PWA manifest link in page shell

optional.name: installKey
optional.feature: First install only: lets a signed-in user run the installer while the roles collection is empty

data.why: Site settings; core Comm email uses settings.domain.
At least one account with roles (installer becomes root).
Home of site-wide code projects and Comm templates.
At least one live (starred) prod default version.
Site-wide handlers and shell files (site-first routing for /cloud and /component).

steps.title: Set required env names on the host app
Make the installer root in roles/{uid} (only while roles is empty)
Create the manage group if missing
Copy Comm templates from the source site
Install the site project from install/site (dev/{vid}, projectId site)
Install product packages through the code-change process
